section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (Study X) involving 228 undergraduate Black female college students (mean age 19.89 years) recruited from psychology courses at a large urban university in the Mid-Atlantic region of the United States. Participants completed an online survey via SONA Systems, and BMI was calculated from self-reported height and weight data (mean BMI = 24.71). The study does not report body appreciation assessments or correlations in this section.
